name: MemGPT
ontology_notes: Historical OS-tier memory from arXiv 2310.08560. Main context is system instructions plus working context plus FIFO queue. External context is recall storage (message DB) and archival storage (paginated text/vector DB). Paper §2. Working context is meant to hold user facts and the agent persona as unstructured text, not typed relationship or lore. Current Letta product is MemFS. Core/recall/archival is retired. Do not implement MemGPT tiers. Historical functions live on letta-ai/letta archive branch in letta/functions/function_sets/base.py (core_memory_append, core_memory_replace, archival_memory_search, conversation_search).

ontology.evidence: Paper §2.1 splits main context (instructions, working context, FIFO queue) from external recall and archival stores. Working context is a writeable text block, not user vs character vs relationship tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: The LLM calls functions to edit working context and archival storage (paper §2.3). Queue manager evicts the FIFO under memory-pressure warnings (paper §2.2). Historical core_memory_append and archival_memory_insert on the archive branch. No extractor that auto-writes every turn. No refusal of poisoned user text.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: In-context tokens are always in the prompt. Out-of-context data is paged in by archival_memory_search or conversation_search (paper Fig. 2, §2.2). The agent can yield without a retrieval call. Pagination exists to avoid overflow.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: core_memory_replace overwrites a substring, including delete via empty new_content (archive base.py). Archival inserts accumulate. Paper has no valid_at. Two contradictory working-context sentences can both remain until the agent edits.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Recall storage keeps message history. DMR asks about prior MSC sessions (paper §3.1.1). Later archive conversation_search has start_date/end_date. Paper itself has no last-Tuesday fact language or validity windows.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Paper §2.1 says working context stores facts about the user and the persona the agent is adopting. That is two blobs in one block, not a relationship type. MSC eval is two human-played personas, not user vs character vs relationship tables.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Search returns matches into main context. Paper and DMR prompts have no skip-relevant-hit control for trauma or spoilers.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: The agent can append user chat into working context via core_memory_append. No trust tags. A jailbreak that the model writes down becomes durable persona text.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Queue eviction drops FIFO messages from main context but keeps them in recall (paper §2.2). core_memory_replace can delete a substring. No user-facing forget-that in the paper.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Each user event can chain multiple LLM calls via request_heartbeat (paper §2.4). Online cost is function-call loops plus embeddings for archival search, not a per-turn extract tax unless the agent writes.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Apache-2.0 LICENSE on letta-ai/letta. Paper experiments used OpenAI GPT-3.5/4 (Table 2). Later Letta can run locally. Historical MemGPT as published needed a function-calling API model.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: 2023 paper and historical server have no MCP memory server. Current Letta is an MCP client, not a MemGPT-tier MCP. See the letta product card.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Historical chat agent with always-on working context for user and persona, plus searchable recall/archival. Still retrieve-or-page then generate. Silence is absent. The agent can poison its own persona. Current Letta is MemFS. Do not implement core/recall/archival.

published_eval.name: Deep memory retrieval (DMR) on Multi-Session Chat, plus conversation-opener engagement, NaturalQuestions-Open document QA, nested KV retrieval
published_eval.claimed_score: DMR GPT-4 Turbo + MemGPT 93.4% accuracy, ROUGE-L recall 0.827 versus GPT-4 Turbo 35.3% / 0.359 (Table 2).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether a session-6 probe about sessions 1-5 matches a gold fact (LLM-judge plus ROUGE-L). Also opener similarity to MSC personas, Wikipedia document QA, and nested UUID lookup. DMR is long-chat fact consistency, not companion identity drift, silence, or poisoning.

open_unknowns: Exact mapping from paper working-context labels to the later Letta human/persona memory blocks on the archive branch.
Whether any DMR run used a write filter, or whether every gold fact had to be self-inserted by the agent.
